title: Generate your music track in Suno 5.5 before building your Seedance 2.0 music…
content:
Generate your music track in Suno 5.5 before building your Seedance 2.0 music video.  
Prepare/clean the audio in CapCut specifically for Seedance 2.0 lipsync before importing it into Seedance.  
Use an image generator (e.g., Grok Imagine or any alternative) to create source images for Seedance 2.0 video generation.  
Assemble the final music video by editing Seedance 2.0 outputs together in CapCut.

Genera tu pista musical en Suno 5.5 antes de crear tu video musical en Seedance 2.0.  
Prepara/limpia el audio en CapCut específicamente para la sincronización labial de Seedance 2.0 antes de importarlo a Seedance.  
Utiliza un generador de imágenes (por ejemplo, Grok Imagine o cualquier alternativa) para crear imágenes fuente para la generación de video en Seedance 2.0.
